messages:
lee_sales: Prospect (RegulatedPayments EU) needs BYO-CMK POC. Must support 45d rotation, dual-custody signing for key ceremony, FIPS attestation, 7y logs, and ability to prove a sample of inference requests were rewrapped with CMK. They also want a clear rollback plan and rough perf/price guidance.
anya_solutions: Short answer: use envelope encryption + sampled per-request proof. Generate ephemeral data keys under customer CMK, cache keys in runtime. For audit: sign a short rewrap-token per-request for a sampled percentage and store token with logs.
chao_security: SOW items: rotation cadence 45d, dual-custody roles & contact list, FIPS attestation delivery schedule, retention 7y, sampling rate for per-request proofs (e.g., 1%), key retention 90d, and rollback runbook. Require customer to whitelist Redwood egress and provide KMS admin contact.
mike_sre: Perf: envelope mode = ~<1ms per request. Sampled per-request proofs add ~3-8ms for the samples only. Full per-request CMK unwrap for all traffic would add 10-30ms and large KMS costs. For POC we can enable 1% sampling to satisfy auditors without big perf hit.
lee_sales: Rollback detail they asked for: what happens if rotation corrupts data keys?
anya_solutions: Runbook (short): canary 5% for 30m, metric gates (errors >0.5% or latency +30ms) -> auto-stop rewrap and switch traffic to prior key version; keep prior key material for 90d; manual key-ceremony to remediate. Add contact and SLAs in SOW.
chao_security: Add: require signed attestation blobs from customer KMS for rotation events and store them with logs. Also require pen-test window before production cutover.
lee_sales: Can someone draft a 2-line customer blurb I can email security?
anya_solutions: Draft: "Redwood supports BYO-CMK via HSM-backed KMS. We recommend envelope encryption with ephemeral data keys derived under your CMK and cached in our runtime to minimize latency. For audit needs we support sampled per-request proofs and full per-call CMK unwrap on request (subject to latency and KMS costs). SOW will record rotation cadence, dual-custody roles, attestation schedule, rollback runbook, and 7-year log retention."
ticket-bot: Created ticket /presales/1719505555-byo-cmk-dual-custody-poc for follow-up.
lee_sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
